The Belt Buckle can be retrieved from [[Woodcutter]]. Speak to the Woodcutter and it will cause a scene with the [[Beekeeper]]. He wants you to dig up a barrel of honey which is located in a dig spot next to [[Tress]]'s home. Dig it up and return it to the Beekeeper. Bring the plaster the Beekeeper gives you to the Woodcutter and he'll give you the {{PAGENAME}}.
